Every value below is sourced from Inworld's OWN pages (inworld.ai / docs.inworld.ai) as reflected in web-search result excerpts that named those pages as the source. Third-party security profiles (e.g. Nudge Security, which claims ISO 27001 / FedRAMP / CSA STAR / PCI for Inworld) were NOT used as sources — those claims are deliberately absent below. The trust center at https://trust.inworld.ai/ exists but its contents could not be read at all this session — it very likely answers the encryption/backup/key questions marked Not known below. Has Inworld formally designated a Data Protection Officer? If yes, please provide the DPO's name and telephone number and/or email; if no, please confirm that privacy@inworld.ai is the authoritative contact for data-protection requests from SAP/Tavus.
